def solve(g):
    ss=shapes(g)
    ups=[s for s in ss if s['cells'][0][0]==s['r0'] and any(c==(s['r0'],(s['c0']+s['c1'])//2) for c in s['cells'])]
    # orientation: up if stem row is above bar row
    ups=[];downs=[]
    for s in ss:
        rows=[p[0] for p in s['cells']]
        # bar = row with 3 cells
        from collections import Counter
        rc=Counter(p[0] for p in s['cells'])
        bar_row=[r for r,n in rc.items() if n==3][0]
        stem_row=[r for r in rows if r!=bar_row][0]
        (ups if stem_row<bar_row else downs).append(s)
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    def place(group, colbase, val):
        group=sorted(group,key=lambda s:(s['r0'],s['c0']))
        n=len(group); k=(n+1)//2
        top=group[:k]; bot=group[k:]
        for sub,grp in ((0,top),(2,bot)):
            grp=sorted(grp,key=lambda s:s['c0'])
            for i,s in enumerate(grp):
                out[sub][colbase+2*i]=val
    place(ups,0,3); place(downs,3,1)
    return out
